status: Silver and expanded EDA confirmed in Fabric; five-table gold build implemented and SQL/calendar checked locally; first gold notebook run pending

time_key.rule: Resolve each source independently against the complete chronological UTC timeline; join on UTC, never displayed local time or row number alone
time_key.end_label: Keep source End date for provenance. Derive actual end from UTC start + 60 minutes; raw wall-clock end labels are misleading at DST transitions.

tables.name: gold.dim_time_hour
rules: UTC keys retain autumn repeated local hour
Month-hour grouping uses local time; chronology and episodes use UTC
Market product resolution is 60 before 2025-10-01 and 15 from that local date; data export resolution remains 60 minutes
day_of_week uses ISO numbering: Monday=1 through Sunday=7

tables.name: gold.dim_market
tables.rule: Not a universal one-to-one relationship; additional markets require an effective-dated mapping

tables.name: gold.dim_generation_source
tables.grain: One of the 12 observed source categories
rules: Pumped-storage output is storage, not an additional renewable source
Combined wind is a source group calculated from onshore and offshore; do not add a thirteenth physical category
Nuclear category remains present with unavailable generation

tables.name: gold.fact_market_hour
tables.construction: Join consumption, price and generation aggregated to one hour using explicit DE/DE-LU pairing; validate one-to-one UTC coverage before writing

tables.name: gold.fact_generation_hour
tables.grain: Physical hour x market x generation source
tables.construction: Join silver long generation to the unique price mapping once; products are hourly exposure components, not realized revenue
tables.null_policy: For missing source generation, volume and exposure components stay null. Valid observed zero generation produces zero exposure and counts as a matched hour.

semantic_model.relationships: Shared time and market dimensions filter both facts, one-to-many and single direction. Generation source filters only generation fact. No fact-to-fact relationships.
semantic_model.geography: Country DE and bidding zone DE-LU remain distinct. First release is fixed to this documented pairing; future countries require an explicit effective-dated country-zone mapping.
semantic_model.date_filters: Use local_date from dim_time_hour for business calendar filtering; UTC for uniqueness and joins.
semantic_model.energy_aggregation: SUM MWh across hours; do not multiply hourly MWh by duration again.
semantic_model.price_aggregation: Time-weighted average across hours; never SUM prices.
semantic_model.weighted_price: SUM(price * grid_load) / SUM(grid_load), with both sums restricted to the same matched valid hours.
semantic_model.hourly_cost_limit: Hourly aggregated prices times hourly energy are an hourly-resolution estimate. They do not reconstruct within-hour price/load covariance or actual settlement costs.
semantic_model.model_decision: Consolidate the consumption and price facts proposed earlier into one hourly market fact. Retain generation by source in a separate fact. This avoids runtime fact-to-fact joins for weighted metrics.

staging_rules: Read UTF-8 BOM and semicolon delimiter; English date labels.
Remove thousands commas, parse decimal point using fixed precision DECIMAL, map '-' to null.
Preserve source file, SHA256, source row number, raw Start date and raw End date.
Keep original row order through DST disambiguation; reject unexpected duplicates, gaps or ordering.
Unpivot generation columns; retain null categories for source fidelity.
Select DE-LU price column explicitly; exclude neighbours average and obsolete DE/AT/LU from project price fact.
Rerun loads by business key without accumulating duplicate rows.
